chitchat: Raven walks once round the resurfacer, kicking each tyre.
He fills the wash-water tank from a hose and watches the gauge.
He pulls the respirator up, takes two breaths through it, and pulls it down again.
He scrapes a ridge of snow off the conditioner into a bucket.
"Blade wants a sharpen," he says, to the blade.
description: A lean man in his fifties in a navy ice-crew parka, RAVEN stencilled across the back. A respirator hangs round his neck on a cracked strap and a ring of keys hangs off his belt. He's wiping down the resurfacer's blade with a rag, one edge at a time.

broadcast.text: "Sped up. They put me through in half a minute while Tug reads out the goals." He folds the rag. "I watched it once. I looked like I was late for something."

bye.text: "Stay off the pad till it's set," he says, and goes back to the blade.

fuel.text: "League fuel." He nods at a drum by the gate with no label on it. "It comes in that. I wear the mask and I don't ask."

machine.text:
"The league's got the one." He pats the flank. "Every barn in the CPhL, she goes on a flatbed and I go in the cab. Twenty-six years."

"Mind, she's older than me in places. The conditioner's off a machine they scrapped in Ashway."

pattern.text:
"Crew pull the nets first. You can't do a crease round a net." He draws it on the boards with a finger. "In by the gate, the middle in four ovals, each one a strip nearer the bench. Then a lap on the inside of the boards and a lap on the boards. Out the way you came."

"Overlap every pass by a few inches or you leave a line. Five and a half minutes, if nobody's left a glove out."

options.label: How do you do the ice?
Do they show you on the broadcast?

root.text: "Mind the edge of the pad," he says. "I've just done it."

text_by_relation.familiar: "Pull up a bucket." He hooks one over with his boot and goes on with the blade.
text_by_relation.first:
The man by the resurfacer pulls his respirator down to his chin.

"Ken Raven. I drive the Zamboni." He taps the machine with the rag. "The league's one, the one on the broadcast. Don't touch the blade."
text_by_relation.known: "You again." He nods and keeps wiping.

clothing_layers: a navy ice-crew parka with RAVEN stencilled across the back
canvas work trousers and cleated rubber boots

name: Ken Raven
